title: Third coordinate of the combined sign vector
statement: For every assignment of signs to coordinates $0$ and $1$, combining it with the fixed assignment that gives coordinate $2$ the value $1$ and coordinate $3$ the value $-1$ produces a sign vector whose coordinate $3$ is $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: The free assignment is an arbitrary function from coordinates $0$ and $1$ to the signs $\{-1,1\}$.
The fixed assignment gives coordinate $2$ the value $1$ and coordinate $3$ the value $-1$.
